title: Lady and the Tramp.
lines: A little dog lives in a beautiful house.
She has long soft ears and a blue collar.
Every morning Lady brings the newspaper upstairs.
Every evening she sleeps in her basket.
Darling is going to have a baby!
Lady doesn't really know what a baby is.
Another dog lives on the street.
He has no home and no collar.
Tramp tells Lady: When a baby comes, nobody will have time for you anymore.
She sees a sweet little baby in a cradle.
She loves the baby straight away.
One day Jim and Darling go on a trip.
They want the fish from the aquarium.
Aunt Sarah thinks Lady did it.
Aunt Sarah buys a muzzle for Lady.
On the street three big dogs find her.
Tramp takes Lady around the city.
A beaver helps gnaw off the muzzle.
That evening they go to a restaurant.
He gives them a big plate of spaghetti and meatballs.
Lady and Tramp eat from the same plate.
They both slurp the same strand of spaghetti.
The next day Lady goes back home.
A big rat is creeping in through the window.
He runs inside and chases the rat away.
At Christmas they're all sitting by the Christmas tree.
Jim, Darling, the baby, Lady and Tramp.
